svg.aria-label: A diffusion model at work. Five squares from left to right: pure noise, then less and less noise as a dendritic cell with its branches appears, until a clean image remains. The model removes a little noise at each step, guided by your prompt.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Diffusion model
svg.text: A diffusion model starts from noise and removes a little at each step
guided by what it learned and by your prompt (“a dendritic cell”)
